about.title: About Us
about.heroDescription: A free collaborative encyclopedia dedicated to the scholars and thinkers of the Islamic intellectual heritage.
about.introLeft: Oulamauna was created with a clear purpose: to preserve the biographies and works of the scholars who shaped Islamic thought, and to make this knowledge easy to find, read, and pass on.
about.introRight: Behind every entry are years of care, driven by our contributors' respect for knowledge and love for the heritage they document.
about.whatBody: We bring biographies, manuscripts, and academic references together in a single multilingual archive.
about.archiveP1: Each entry brings together a scholar's biography, notable works, and available manuscripts in one place, in Arabic, English, and French.
about.archiveP2: To keep entries reliable, we ask contributors to cite their sources, and every contribution goes through a review before it is published.
about.accessBody: At Oulamauna, openness is the core of our work. We believe scholarly heritage should be easy to reach and easy to understand.
about.accessSub: That is why every entry is free to read in three languages, so no single language limits who can learn from it.
about.teamBody: Our contributors are not just people who add names — they are researchers and readers with deep respect for the heritage they document. Their care for sources and accuracy is what keeps the archive trustworthy.
about.ctaTitle: Do you have a correction, a suggestion for a scholar to add, or a question about the archive? We'd be glad to hear from you.
